aboutGame.title: What is Squadron 42?
paragraphs: Squadron 42 is a cinematic single-player space combat game set in the Star Citizen universe. You enlist as a rookie pilot in the United Empire of Earth (UEE) Navy and fight through a story-driven campaign of tactical dogfights, boarding actions, and large-scale fleet battles aboard the Idris-class frigate UEES Stanton.

Developed by Cloud Imperium Games under director Chris Roberts, Squadron 42 pairs a Hollywood performance-capture cast with detailed spacecraft and Newtonian 6DoF combat. Our wiki covers its ships, missions, weapons, characters, and systems with practical guides and walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Squadron 42.

items.question: What is Squadron 42?
items.answer: Squadron 42 is a cinematic single-player space combat game set in the Star Citizen universe. You enlist in the UEE Navy and fight through a story-driven campaign featuring dogfights, boarding actions, and large-scale fleet battles.

items.question: What platforms is Squadron 42 on?
items.answer: Squadron 42 is developed for PC on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) and is planned for release through the official RSI website and Steam.

items.question: Is Squadron 42 the same as Star Citizen?
items.answer: No. Squadron 42 is a standalone single-player campaign set in the same universe as the Star Citizen persistent-universe MMO, with its own missions, progression, and save system.

items.question: Does Squadron 42 have active codes?
items.answer: Squadron 42 does not use redeemable codes. There are currently 0 active codes, and any codes circulating online are not official.

items.question: When does Squadron 42 release?
items.answer: Cloud Imperium Games announced the feature-complete milestone in late 2023 and is targeting a 2026 release window for Squadron 42 while the campaign continues its optimization and polish phase.

items.question: How long is the Squadron 42 campaign?
items.answer: Squadron 42 spans 28 chapters and dozens of missions, mixing space dogfights, capital ship operations, and first-person boarding combat across the Odin system.
